entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. To continue in English, press one.
Connecting you to a VeloFit support agent now.
Thank you for calling VeloFit support, my name is David. How can I assist you today?
Hi David, I'm calling to inquire about a return for a helmet I bought a little while ago.
I can definitely look into that for you. Can I get your name and order number to pull up the account?
Yes, the name is Sarah Jenkins, and the order number should be VF-551290.

Thank you, Sarah. I see the order here for the Urban Commuter Helmet in Midnight Blue. To understand the situation better, what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or a matter of preference?
It's really just a preference thing. The color wasn't quite what I expected, and I found another one I like better. The box is still unopened, I never even touched the helmet itself.
I understand. It's important you're completely satisfied with your gear, especially when it comes to safety. Let me just check the delivery date here... looks like it arrived 50 days ago.

Okay, one moment while I confirm the policy for you... Yes, it looks like you're all set. Our policy allows for returns within 90 days of delivery, so you are well within that window. I can approve this return for a full refund immediately.

Oh, that's excellent news. Thank you. Since I am returning it with the box unopened and it's in perfect resellable condition, would it be possible to also get a 10% discount code for my next VeloFit order? I plan on buying the replacement helmet from you.

That's a reasonable question, Sarah. I appreciate you planning to shop with us again. Unfortunately, my system doesn't allow me to generate discount codes for returns. However, I have just processed the return authorization, and you'll receive an email with a pre-paid shipping label within the hour to send the helmet back at no cost to you.
Okay, a full refund and free return shipping is fair enough. I can accept that. Thank you for your help.
You're very welcome. Once we receive the item, your refund will be processed back to your original payment method. Is there anything else I can help with today?
No, that's everything. Thanks again, David.
My pleasure. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day!
